title: Benchmarking hospitals
bodyMd: Two hospitals compare average waiting times. One treats a much larger share of urgent cases, which are prioritized ahead of routine appointments. A report ranks hospitals using only their overall average. A researcher recommends separate comparisons within urgency categories and an explicit description of how category results are combined. She notes that the overall figures answer a different question from like-for-like performance.
